messages.subject: Guillera-Arroita 2011 JABES transect model
parts:
Is the Guillera-Arroita 2011 JABES transect occupancy model, the MMPP model, available in unmarked?  The title of the paper is 'Species occupancy modeling for detection data collected along a transect'.  I did not see the reference cited in the September 2015 version of the package documentation.

Thanks,

Mark
